features: GO ANYWHERE, PRO EVERYTHING. The Redmi Pad Pro boasts a stunning 12.1-inch (30.7cm) XL Display powered by the Snapdragon 7s Gen 2 processor. Superfast Wi-Fi 6 keeps you connected, while Face Unlock provides secure access. Immerse yourself in captivating viewing experience with Dolby Vision Atmos with XL display and quad speakers.
CONNECTIVITY: Stay connected almost everywhere. Wi-Fi 6 delivers lightning-fast wireless connections for seamless file transfers, even for large videos and documents.

LARGER THAN LIFE DISPLAY: Immerse yourself in a world of stunning visuals with the expansive 30.7cm(12.1-inch) XL display. The display boasts a buttery-smooth 120Hz AdaptiveSync refresh rate for seamless visuals, whether you're gaming, scrolling, or watching movies. The razor-sharp 2.5K resolution ensures crisp details, while the 600-nit peak brightness brings out the vibrancy in every image. Dolby Vision support enables viewing of your favourite Dolby Vision OTT content. Plus, with triple eye-care technology, your eyes will thank you for the comfortable viewing experience, even during extended sessions.

IMMERSIVE AUDIO: Quad speakers deliver crystal-clear sound, ensuring you hear every detail, from the subtlest notes to the most intense dialogues. Dolby Atmos further enhances the experience, creating a captivating soundscape that puts you right in the center of the action.

BEST IN CLASS BATTERY: Unleash your adventures with the Redmi Pad Pro's massive 10000mAh (typ) battery. Power through long days or weekend escapes - 33.9 days standby or 16 hours of HD video playback on a single charge. Need a digital detox? Enjoy up to 17 hours reading time, unplugged. And when you do need to refuel, the included 33W fast charger gets you back up and running in no time.
